findings.test_recommendation: Build dnsmasq with DNSSEC support (-DHAVE_DNSSEC). Set up a test zone with a wildcard record *.example.com. Query for *.example.com with DNSSEC validation enabled. Before the patch: may return SERVFAIL. After the patch: returns NOERROR with the wildcard answer. Also test a.example.com (exists and does not exist) to verify no regression.
